title: Grateful Dead Live at NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadow Park on 1969-07-11
venue: NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadow Park
source: SBD Recording Info: Pat Lee from Dick Latvala 1985 Technics 1506> Yamaha K2000 MSC > C > C > CD; Transfer Info: Mastered via the Apogee Mini Me(24/96) > Mini Dac > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > TLH Flac8; Transferred and Edited By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a stellar ’69 show, highlighted by an emotional “Death Don't Have No Mercy” and crystal‑clear stage detail.
ai_review.review: The three fan reviews are uniformly enthusiastic, calling this the best ‘69 they’ve heard and praising the superb, almost flawless sound quality that lets you hear every nuance onstage. The performance is described as uplifting from the first note with a standout rendition of “Death Don't Have No Mercy,” though one reviewer notes the missing “Lovelight” cut.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews give 5‑star ratings, lauding both the musical performance and the recording’s clarity; no criticisms aside from a missing song fragment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly mention “fantastic” and “amazing” quality, noting crystal‑clear detail and the ability to hear everything happening on stage.

standout_songs: The Death Don't Have No Mercy
show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic and cohesive from start to finish, with a powerful jam feel; reviewers say it makes you smile right away.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drums are highlighted as “crazy” during the jams, indicating an especially dynamic performance.
